text:
The plate looks like a paper plate of about 18-20 cm across (roughly 260 px in the image). It holds about 14 grapes, mostly red with a couple of green ones. Each grape is roughly 25-30 px long, which works out to about 2-3 cm, so each weighs around 5-6 g. That gives about 14 × 5.5 ≈ 77 g, and I'll round up to about 80 g. At roughly 0.69 kcal/g, that is about 55 kcal.
